programme.desc: Dr Matt and the keepers at Flamingoland come up with a cunning plan as they face the difficult task of trying to move a three and a half ton white rhino to Sweden On a much smaller scale, an abandoned rabbit with an urgent dental problem and Matt discovers that picking up a penguin isn't as easy as it sounds

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Comedian Alan Davies is acting vet's assistant at Harmsworth animal hospital in London He's helping out with a case of two Staffordshire Bull Terrier sisters who have had a major falling out With fur flying, one has ended up with nasty wounds to her neck and mouth Alan helps vet Sam to access and treat the injuries and also learns how to keep your pets from fighting

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch

programme.title: I Can't Breathe
programme.desc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores In 2015, David Dungay Jr, an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents “When I see black America, I see part of myself When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists Because it is there Because it can touch my life at any time”

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Killing Field

programme.title: Peace On The Tigris
programme.desc: The Tigris River, which was the site of the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, still flows majestically through Baghdad, Iraq's capital In March2003, the area around this river underwent intense airstrikes by US and British forces The US armed forces gained control of Baghdad Journalist Watai Takeharu witnessed the moment when the bronze statue of then-president Saddam Hussein was pulled down The next day he saw many victims of the airstrikes at a city hospital There he met 31-year-old Ali Saqban, whose home had been destroyed in the bombing In his arms he was carrying his 5-year-old daughter Shahad, whose body was covered with blood

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 1
programme.desc: 8位網紅大廚展開競賽

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 2
programme.desc: 海選迎來下一組參賽者,家庭主廚各顯神通

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 3
programme.desc: 海選最後一回合,8位專業大廚必須讓評審驚豔,從而擠身下回合

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 4
programme.desc: 被認可的15 位大廚跟導師配對,並接受他們的首個團隊挑戰;每位大廚必須創造一道令人難以置信的意大利菜

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 5
programme.desc: 大廚們各顯神通烹製出最美味的燒烤盛宴;兩位大廚在淘汰環節正面交鋒,用椰菜花烹製一道高級菜餚

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 6
programme.desc: 導師們向大廚們發起挑戰,讓他們製作出最令人印象深刻的拉麵菜式,但他們要在整個過程中於一個快速上下移動的平台進行挑戰

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 7
programme.desc: 在幾位驚喜的幫廚協助下,大廚們齊心協力烹製出一頓五道菜大餐為了成功完成這項挑戰,大廚們必須依靠彼此的烹飪和溝通技巧

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 8
programme.desc: 餘下的大廚們被委派去烤,蒸或炸

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 9
programme.desc: 大廚們在比賽中首次不再團隊合作,而是獨力完成下一個烹飪挑戰並生存下來

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 10
programme.desc: 餘下的大廚們被委派烹煮揉合南方風味和法國特色的卡津菜;創造出最佳菜餚的大廚將獲得令人垂涎的時間代幣,那會為他們在下次挑戰中帶來巨大優勢

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 11
programme.desc: 大廚們嘗試西班牙美食,從小食開始,到中場墜落平台,導致經典搭配;三位大廚在淘汰賽中繼續準備他們的西班牙菜,送上色彩鮮豔的西班牙海鮮飯

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 12
programme.desc: 最後六名廚師必須烹煮帶骨的蛋白質,在緊絀的時間下可算是個壯舉;兩位廚師在淘汰賽中決一死戰,他們有一群魚可供選擇

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 13
programme.desc: 餘下五位廚師的任務是反傳統菜式:重現哥頓藍斯的招牌惠靈頓牛排,但不能有牛肉;兩名廚師免遭淘汰,其餘三名廚師進行最後一場對決

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 4 # 14
programme.desc: 最後三強廚師必須在90分鐘時限內炮製出一頓出色的三道菜餐單

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 1
programme.desc: 8位網紅在3個級數的廚房對壘爭奪大獎

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 2
programme.desc: 海選仍然繼續,家庭的大廚們搶奪夢寐以求的5個名額之一,從而進入導師團選學員階段

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 3
programme.desc: 試鏡結束後,專業廚師們搶奪夢寐以求的5個名額之一

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 4
programme.desc: 排名前15名的廚師被選入3支隊伍;參賽者必須準備全美式碎肉餅漢堡來證明他們的烹飪能力

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 5
programme.desc: 剩下的14位廚師被指派在30分鐘內準備一道震撼的咖哩菜式;獲勝的菜式使整隊獲得豁免,並在下次挑戰中獲得高級廚房

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 6
programme.desc: 剩下的13位廚師在準備一道受熱帶島嶼美食啟發的海鮮菜式時,展現了他們的度假氛圍;獲勝的菜式使整隊獲得豁免,並在下次挑戰中獲得高級廚房

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 7
programme.desc: 廚師們被委派準備更高層次的國際街頭美食;在整個挑戰過程中,平台都會不斷移動

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 8
programme.desc: 剩下的廚師在各自的團隊中庖丁解牛,以製作鐵板牛扒菜式;2名參賽者在進入激烈的海鮮鬥地煮時面臨淘汰

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 9
programme.desc: 剩下的10名參賽者踏入廚房,只為將傳統薄餅提升為更高層次的傑作;獲勝的薄餅使整隊獲得豁免,並可以使用高級廚房

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 10
programme.desc: 廚師們使用平台上的大量新鮮食材,準備最好的希臘主菜,為他們的團隊贏得豁免權

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 11
programme.desc: 剩下的8名大廚必須分組合作,製作出一頓環環緊扣的3道菜大餐;距離比賽只剩 30 分鐘,獲勝的菜單確保隊伍免被淘汰

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 12
programme.desc: 剩下的7位廚師各自為便當製作受日本啟發的菜式; 1名評審在淘汰賽中負責監督廚師,而2名評審則負責盲測他們的作品

programme.title: 主廚顛峰之戰 3 # 13

programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 鋼琴大師的生命樂章
programme.desc: 巴哈, 莫劄特, 貝多芬, 蕭邦 - 四位誇越時代的鋼琴大師,在他們的生命樂章裏面,上帝的音符不斷跳動,並且影響後世無數音樂家。國際知名鋼琴家Sandra Wright Shen,曾獲得多個國際鋼琴大賽的冠軍,她將會為我們分享四位鋼琴大師的信仰故事。

programme.desc: 一顆擋不住的野心，讓慈禧開展長達四十七年的垂簾聽政，到底慈禧太后是如何誕生？她的同治中興、洋務運動，是否功不補過？成為皇帝的奶媽，榮華富貴享之不盡！中原賤人館的羅拔和陳仔公開皇室御用奶媽的甄選條件。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 今集邀得梁漢文、方力申兩位帥哥，Do姐顯得心花怒放，並大談歐、美、日乘計程車的「畀貼士」文化。台灣「問題專員」走進樓上舖，享受「電鑽男」既刺激又舒暢的服務，到底「搞邊科」？緊接「試食題」，名廚即場以小牛的某部位烹調美食，梁漢文「瞓身」使用雙重錦囊，看來對答中食材胸有成竹！K小姐介紹韓國百貨店中一件男女老幼皆適用的產品，是甚麼東西？踏入積分兌換貨幣環節，有嘉賓不聽隊友意見，結果看着對手「執到寶」！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫絞盡腦汁，以一段中西愛情故事介紹張曦雯、蔡思貝、陳嘉寶和賴慰玲四位美女嘉賓，Do姐尚算滿意。K小姐試坐韓國飛碟形觀光塔，「升空」時還獲派神秘黃色物件，有何用途？泰國一間特色餐廳可品嚐各款「加料」營養美食，究竟是甚麼主題食肆？台灣一輛「好玩的士」不但提供「看戲」、「唱K」服務，只要客人做到某件事，更不收車資！兩隊組員在兌換貨幣環節「心水」不一，要藉「包剪揼」決定地方，最終可會得到幸運之神眷顧？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 暑假開始，奇蹟閃耀組等人一起到海灘度假，閃亮CHU起初以為能在海邊盡情玩樂，到場才發現需要接受吉祥物認證測驗。相對積極應試的玫露熊與菈比莉，閃亮CHU完全無法集中精神，更連續考得不及格的成績……

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄問小夫借書，卻被胖虎強行搶走，大雄於是用多啦美借出的「隱形眼藥水」，變身隱形人整治胖虎。媽媽遺失了門匙，多啦A夢用「升降板」上到一樓高度回到家中，卻意外發現多了一片大空地遊玩。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 撫子用營火自製甘酒曲奇吃，之後凜與綾乃亦抵達，三人搭營後開始準備晚餐。撫子參考水壩咖哩飯，炮製出畑薙水壩紅酒燴牛肉漢堡排蛋包飯，三人吃得極滿意。天將亮，早起的綾乃和撫子一起觀看晨曦。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 陳貝兒分析出「丹麥人生幸福五部曲」，丹麥人在人生多個階段都可獲政府資助，享有良好福利。不過，這些幸福卻不屬異國人妻享有！對Perla而言，幸福只是有個完整的家，每晚聽到枕邊人打鼾便夠。夫妻總有爭執時，Perla曾為教子方向而與丈夫爭執，甚至聲稱搬返香港，Jesper最終如何打圓場？此次丹麥之旅，貝兒還參觀當地幼稚園及老人院。幼稚園佈置得像主題樂園，老人院設個人獨立廁所，設施齊備，實在令人妒忌！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 譚俊彥、陳煒各自獻上「鹹鮮二重奏」！煒哥以鮮蠔仔及蠔豉炮製「富蠔煎米粉」，先將米粉煎至金黃香脆，看煒哥的拋鑊功架！菜式加入豬脢肉及九層塔同炒，煒哥以甚麼方法巧妙地保留蠔仔的鮮味？俊彥則帶來西式菜「慢煮西班牙黑毛豬孖寶卷」，即席請教鼎爺去豬肉筋位的方法。俊彥將豬肉拍扁，捲入風乾火腿、鼠尾草慢煮再煎香；炒香洋蔥、茴香等，配上粉嫩豬肉卷，層次感豐富。俊彥的菜式憑賣相先聲奪人，味道方面可跑贏煒哥的鮮蠔嗎？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 煒哥和俊彥分別帶來中、西式龍蝦菜式預祝聖誔。煒哥在鼎爺指導下，以龍蝦鬚為新鮮龍蝦放尿，然後起出龍蝦肉煎香，以龍蝦殼炮製龍蝦湯，再以龍蝦頭尾伴碟，物盡其用製成甚有睇頭的「脆米龍蝦泡飯」。想炸出鬆化脆米有何技巧？波士頓龍蝦有雙大蟹鉗，看三姐示範完整起出龍蝦肉。俊彥炮製西式「慢煮龍蝦班尼迪蛋包」，經過慢煮的龍蝦肉落鑊煎香，配合自製水波蛋、荷蘭醬，更有魚子醬做點綴！兩道菜式矜貴兼有派頭，實在太難選出贏家！

programme.title: 世紀工程︰機場三跑道系統粵
初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐示範鹹豆漿。她這次用了新穎的組合去烹調，如櫻花蝦、飯素和紫菜，還有其他常見的配料，如榨菜、米醋和油條。她提到烹煮豆漿時不需要煮至沸騰，把所有材料放進碗裡後，把剛沸騰的豆漿倒進去便可以享用。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 崔建邦憑著靈活口才贏得「金牌司儀」美譽，這次，他還要向「金牌甜品師」古嘉俊拜師，學做一款口味豐富的「熱情果薑味焦糖朱古力」。口味隨年紀轉變，崔建邦亦逐漸遠離甜食，這款甜品卻何以令他重拾童年感覺？

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿驅加入阿渡的隊伍，一行人去到舉行儀式的地方，按照瑪蘿手上的食譜把七彩方塊烹調後，方塊竟然懂得開口說話，此時阿翔和麥格來襲，苦戰期間，龍神用問答方式幫助阿渡探索內心真正的願望。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 生命是多姿多采的，「My Little Show」有十三位可愛小朋友，一同透過歌曲<生命有價，呼籲大家多點微笑、讚賞，保持正面和積極的態度來面對人生起伏。另有四位小朋友穿起四種不同顏色的舞衣，帶來一段節奏輕快的cha cha cha舞蹈。有表演者認為最重要是享受過程，觀眾又可會樂在其中？結他導師邀請玲玲姐姐和Chloe姐姐，試以兩首經典動畫歌曲勾起大家的童年回憶。如果可以擁有一件法寶，會是甚麼？

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐獲贈一批漂亮的二手衣服。小丸子覺得不公平，於是要求姐姐在現有的衣服之中，讓小丸子挑選一件據為己有。小丸子聽了濱治說的，關於鏡子的恐怖故事之後十分害怕，變得對所有鏡子疑神疑鬼。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近期美日兩國聯手干預日圓匯市，對有投資當地房地產的港人，及賣日本貨的零售商有何影響？飲食業市道艱難，美食廣場這種集合餐飲的營運模式，生意做得如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 中六學生大學聯招派位結果出爐，有人報喜，有人煩惱，成績不理想、考試一時失手的學生該何去何從？入讀本地大學是不是唯一出路？暑假將至，中六學生告別舊校，準備迎接不同大學生活，而選擇不繼續升學的，同樣可以找到自己的方向，發展所長。

programme.title: 中年好聲音4登峯之戰直播粵
programme.desc: 七強唱將尹景順、尤淑情、許雲妮、許美琪、吳亦偉、蔡宓婕、鄭家聲，將於啟德體藝館上演登峯之戰。殿堂級歌手李克勤、巫啟賢應邀擔任星級評判，聯同肥媽、周國豐、張佳添、海兒、谷婭溦，組成陣容鼎盛的七人專業評審團，嚴格把關眾選手的歌藝評核。參賽者輪流登場演唱快、慢歌，最高積分三人將晉身終極比拼，再唱一曲力爭總冠軍寶座。觀眾們亦可參與「觀眾最愛好聲音」與「誰是冠軍」投票，大家手中的每一票，都可能改寫冠軍賽果！

programme.title: 一周星星直播粵
programme.desc: 隨着精彩的演出結束，《中年好聲音4》的終極舞台也在一片掌聲中圓滿落幕，各大榮譽獎項亦已名花有主。延伸這份得獎的感動，《一周星星》這集主持許文軒會即席在決賽現場訪問新鮮出爐的冠、亞、季軍唱將，探聽各人一路走來的心路歷程及得獎感受。此外，所屬親友亦應邀亮相，分享親身見證三甲歌者圓夢時刻的喜悅。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 張與辰造訪將韓式炸雞引入本地的始祖店，品嚐蜂蜜蒜蓉炸雞，並向店主請教炮製酥脆炸雞的秘訣。胡美貽帶黃嘉雯到位於尖沙咀的隱世中菜館，細嚐瀨尿蝦粉絲煲、陳皮叉燒包等特色招牌菜。美食KOL Arthur則帶倪嘉雯走訪銅鑼灣話題新店，享用帝王蟹腸粉、紅燒鮑魚花膠意大利飯等創意料理，充滿驚喜。北角一間點心店推出超值優惠，包括9元1粒燒賣、10元1粒蝦餃及12元1個蟹肉灌湯小籠包，還有多款20元以下的美食選擇。

programme.desc: 陳貝兒分析出「丹麥人生幸福五部曲」，丹麥人在人生多個階段都可獲政府資助，享有良好福利。不過，這些幸福卻不屬異國人妻享有！對Perla而言，幸福只是有個完整的家，每晚聽到枕邊人打鼾便夠。夫妻總有爭執時，Perla曾為教子方向而與丈夫爭執，甚至聲稱搬返香港，Jesper最終如何打圓場？此次丹麥之旅，貝兒還參觀當地幼稚園及老人院。幼稚園佈置得像主題樂園，老人院設個人獨立廁所，設施齊備，實在令人妒忌！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 譚俊彥、陳煒各自獻上「鹹鮮二重奏」！煒哥以鮮蠔仔及蠔豉炮製「富蠔煎米粉」，先將米粉煎至金黃香脆，看煒哥的拋鑊功架！菜式加入豬脢肉及九層塔同炒，煒哥以甚麼方法巧妙地保留蠔仔的鮮味？俊彥則帶來西式菜「慢煮西班牙黑毛豬孖寶卷」，即席請教鼎爺去豬肉筋位的方法。俊彥將豬肉拍扁，捲入風乾火腿、鼠尾草慢煮再煎香；炒香洋蔥、茴香等，配上粉嫩豬肉卷，層次感豐富。俊彥的菜式憑賣相先聲奪人，味道方面可跑贏煒哥的鮮蠔嗎？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 煒哥和俊彥分別帶來中、西式龍蝦菜式預祝聖誔。煒哥在鼎爺指導下，以龍蝦鬚為新鮮龍蝦放尿，然後起出龍蝦肉煎香，以龍蝦殼炮製龍蝦湯，再以龍蝦頭尾伴碟，物盡其用製成甚有睇頭的「脆米龍蝦泡飯」。想炸出鬆化脆米有何技巧？波士頓龍蝦有雙大蟹鉗，看三姐示範完整起出龍蝦肉。俊彥炮製西式「慢煮龍蝦班尼迪蛋包」，經過慢煮的龍蝦肉落鑊煎香，配合自製水波蛋、荷蘭醬，更有魚子醬做點綴！兩道菜式矜貴兼有派頭，實在太難選出贏家！

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.desc: 亨本欲向麗作出表白，但卻為眾人阻止。原來他們想替亨出謀獻策，讓他奪得美人歸。首先眾人要亨不動聲色地向麗大獻殷勤，麗不虞有詐，繼續全單照收。接著眾人要亨製造機會以拖著高麗的手，從而測試麗的反應。

食平3D粵
programme.desc: 近年的番薯竟然種出雪糕味，「一個人的晚餐」肥媽用雪糕味番薯做出番薯味雪糕！肥媽一次忘記煮晚飯，錯有錯着下發明了「雙響牛角酥」，有何厲害之處？至於「燒雞胸配甜椒茴香沙律」，適合喜歡清淡的朋友享用。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 久未於鏡頭前下廚的黃淑儀再顯廚藝，教煮「蒜蓉牛油白蘭地蝦」與「鮮菇涼瓜鹹酸菜」。示範前，她還貼心為入廚新手介紹量度調味料份量的標準方法。臨床腫瘤科醫生提醒，長期飲用超過攝氏65度的飲品，會增加患食道癌風險，日常飲食要注意甚麼？吸煙、飲酒、長期胃酸倒流等，亦屬食道癌的高危因素。由於食道癌早期症狀並不明顯，醫生提到若持續出現吞嚥困難，應盡快求醫，並帶來診治資訊。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「牛肉秋葵卷」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 深入珠海古色古香的村莊，團隊一探「泥煨雞」香嫩多汁的秘密。深圳新派川菜館主打酸菜魚，魚肉選用肉質滑嫩的鱸魚，味道酸辣適中。人氣卷蛋店大排長龍，主持們試盡生椰芒芒、黑金抹茶等四款滋味。大飽口福後往水療中心叉電，游泳、按摩、唱K等活動輪住體驗，壓力一掃而空！香港鬧市中可找到日本昭和氛圍，日式餐廳的裝潢與料理設計別具心思，邊吃邊打卡。精品粵菜套餐有齊海味一品煲、蒸馬友、花膠雞湯等美饌，更有「吃貨」着數？

programme.title: 東坡家事#30粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)少游自首，皇上稱已知一切；原來閏之告密認為東坡不忠不義，恨不得煎東坡皮，食東坡肉；被判烹刑的東坡告知閏之可另找歸宿。皇上微服出巡，聽到不同百姓為東坡事件爭拗。新任御膳房總管帶來多盅「東坡肉」上殿……

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 警察在學校用腹語術宣揚交通安全，小丸子見到後想起自己曾買腹語術人偶，於是約藤木同山田一起重操腹語術。小丸子見到其他人都有參與課外活動，自己也想效法，並在因緣際會下開始學吹陶笛。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 減碳綠色生活早已成為全球共識，有環保建築師積極倡導「循環建築」理念，致力從源頭着手，盡力減少工程廢料的產生，還希望減少碳排放，促進可持續發展。建築師亮相節目，直言實踐過程中最棘手的並非技術難題，而是如何讓業主與用家改變想法？竹用作建築物料已有長遠歷史，如今在現代科技的加持下，已蛻變成壽命更長、更具環保效益的「工程竹」。嘉賓除了介紹使用工程竹建造的本地建築物，還攜來相關組件的模型，讓大家一開眼界。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄偷用「惡魔卡」換錢，每次都會縮短身高，最後險些消失，多啦A夢靠放大電筒救回他，卻阻不了他再起貪念。大雄借助「繪畫帽」與畫筆畫出逼真圖畫，雖幫人解決難題，卻因太像相片而鬧出笑話。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.desc: 5,000萬元以上的豪宅，上半年交投急升逾四成，九龍站樓價處於甚麼水平？是否入市時機？

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#11粵
programme.desc: 唐芯入股嘉驄的「開心小棧」，與好友盧漢娜、鐵金剛合力將之改造成青年旅舍兼共享空間。附近雜貨店的貓遭人抱走，監控錄像拍下偷貓賊的大概容貌。唐芯等人決心尋回失貓，追查下發現近日還有多宗失貓個案，疑為同一人所為。憑嘉驄提供的線索，眾人終於找到偷貓賊，並暗中跟蹤蒐證，卻遇上阻滯。偷貓賊後來竟現身小棧，似有目的而來……其後，偷貓賊有所行動，疑欲加害流浪貓，眾人遂出手阻止，並當面質問其偷貓一事，詎料……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#16粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如、家謙聯手，向繼威施加壓力，逼使繼威向雪文求婚。雪文被繼威的甜言蜜語打動，答應求婚。為令幸如難看，雪文更故意在公司當眾邀請幸如出席婚禮，沒料到幸如竟大方答應。幸如目睹曉彤與哲朗的矛盾，並意外撞見曉彤偷哭的脆弱一幕。幸如聆聽並開解曉彤，二人漸成朋友。幸如憑着曉彤的協助，成功爭取向床品公司匯報的機會。雪文找來演員假扮其母親出席婚禮。幸如等人埋首床品公司的廣告，準備出發匯報之時，卻遭人暗地妨礙。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#21粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語代替貞貞做高考促銷直播，並大獲成功。直播結束後，紀封本想單獨約蜜語，芷純卻拉著兩人一起慶功，更回憶往事，暗示想與紀封復合，蜜語黯然離場。有考生遺失助聽器，其母大鬧前台，蜜語為此冒著大雨去追垃圾車…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 由海底火山噴發而成的加拉帕戈斯群島，環境保護法例極嚴格；芷珮提醒到機場轉機前在網上填好登島表格，減少誤點風險！她決定隨導遊開展行程，既省時間，也令每個步驟都清晰，事關坐完水上的士又要轉車……踏上群島，芷珮深入火山「裂縫」內浮潛消暑，兼近距離接觸海洋生物，卻建議中午前來，為甚麼？走訪巨龜保護區，她跟巨型象龜打招呼，還見識到牠們自行挖湖的智慧！想醫肚兼買手信，聽導遊推介到Santa Cruz島就沒錯！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

再創世紀#29粵PG
programme.desc: 定垚為救程凱前途，使計令天生發現超級電池的報告，天生因起疑終止合作。啟堂怒責定垚從中作梗，父女大鬧一場。澤雨因受騙借酒澆愁，端兒透露會到上海發展，鼓勵澤雨振作。高哲以優厚條件為誘，遊說程凱接受彼列基金投資。力晨為查季生罪證，偷走了明晞的秘密電腦，結果……明晞發現天生用另一名字處理賬目，恍然二人並非共同進退。兆齊向證監會告發賀天生內幕交易，天生卻不以為然。高哲約見定垚，提醒她啟堂搶回主席之位的野心。

programme.desc: 肥媽煮排骨確有一手，「陳皮骨」有何秘訣？黑蒜近年成為養生食物新寵，生吃口感微酸且甜，加入蜜豆炒帶子最適合。學習「粟米牛奶濃湯」製法外，且看六號示範「極速粟米起粒法」。肥媽還炮製甜品「黃糖肉桂蝴蝶酥」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 斑禿俗稱「鬼剃頭」，其實是一種跟免疫系統相關的脫髮？有指壓力是成因之一，專科醫生有甚麼看法？斑禿與一般脫髮如何分辨？醫生指出，服用免疫調節藥物的治療過程需時，患者要抱有耐性。貝安琪於劇集《非份之罪》與吳啟華合演夫妻，她既是演員也是瑜伽導師，如何兼顧兩項工作，並同時好好照顧九歲兒子？安琪還即席示範幾個簡單的瑜伽動作，讓觀眾亦可修習，舒展筋骨。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐奉上消暑美食「碗仔素翅冬瓜盅」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 打卡是許多人旅遊的主要目的，主持們往珠海的北山會館古建築打卡之餘，還喝涼茶、雞尾酒，更深入區內一試重慶火鍋，刺激！深圳亦有攝影勝地，歡迎各少女打卡朝聖，場地還提供下午茶餐，也可餵餵羊駝。轉進商場，品嚐海南風味，燒雞皮竟可以脆如薯片？在香港，堅尼地城也有不少打卡點，夜了不妨吃煲仔飯及即蒸點心醫肚，指定時段七折供應！銅鑼灣火鍋店亦有型格壁畫讓顧客自拍，身為吃貨當然要享用龍蝦冬蔭功湯底，打個着數邊爐。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG AI 點只科技股粵

programme.title: 天梯#1粵
programme.desc: 苗天與妻子顧新月在深山隱居，為了方便妻子上下山，花四十年親手開鑿數千級的「愛情天梯」。一九三四年，苗天領導村民種植名貴藥材，把藥材運到廣州售賣。新月兒子思行因門牙脫落久未長出新牙，被同學取笑不肯上學。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 佐佐木爺爺受傷，小丸子叫來爸爸幫忙，結果收到特級酒作為謝禮，為了喝到好酒，爸爸也變得勤快起來。小丸子因為不想在體育課上跑步，於是跳起祈雨舞，食髓知味的她居然為測驗要求爸爸戒酒。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈的朋友火箭菜姐姐，首次到來協助管理零食廠，四位零食小兵隨即聽從其指令，比拼「廠長話」遊戲。曲奇隊的男生一直望着旁邊，動作稍有遲疑，就成為第一個被淘汰之人……火箭菜姐姐要求兩隊分別在果園內摘取五個指定水果，薯片隊兩名女兵分工清晰，不足一分鐘就過關！曲奇小兵略有緊張，拿完水果便想折返起點？最後的任務是運送雪糕球走過「溶化之橋」，有小兵起步不久就把雪糕球弄跌了，看來需要更多打氣聲和鼓勵。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 果Jam叔叔說將會前往雪童子山，對此深感興趣的咖哩包超人決定先行一步。因為麵粉用光，果Jam叔叔拜託火車頭人前往山羊叔叔的住處領取麵粉。細菌人認為這是打擊麵包超人的好機會，於是出手阻止。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 體外受精及胚胎移植(IVF)，俗稱試管嬰兒，療程涉及從女士的卵巢中抽取卵子，讓精子和卵子在體外受精結合，培養成胚胎後再移植回女士的子宮內。這種受孕治療最新發展如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 2026香港小姐 敢．至完美粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#12粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄遲遲未成家立室，嘉冰不禁憂心，更夢見先父責成她催促嘉驄早日成婚、繼後香燈。為此，嘉冰加緊為嘉驄物色對象，更設下連串考驗，終於找到理想人選Becca。Becca不但不抗拒嘉驄，更對他表現進取。嘉驄因情路屢受挫折而猶疑不決，聽從「開心小棧」住客楊光的建議後，遂與Becca嘗試約會，豈料對方竟有意想不到的「安排」……其後，Becca到訪萬里家中，親自為眾人下廚，儼然以家人自居，卻逐漸露出真本性……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#17粵
programme.desc: 幸如等人因遇上突發狀況，失去向床品公司匯報的機會。眾人轉而利用網絡力量，終成功得到床品公司這個廣告客戶。家謙超額完成業績，不料啟榮交出更亮眼成績，兄弟競爭愈發激烈。守業為保工作，再次情緒勒索美淇，美淇在問責大會上助他逃過一劫。及後，其昌信心十足地匯報賢淑薈萃活動的宣傳意念……終於來到繼威、雪文婚禮當天。幸如盛裝出席，要見證雪文與繼威踏入不幸婚姻生活的起點。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 紀封徹夜照料生病的蜜語，秀梅藉探望之名帶寄舟上門。寄舟邀蜜語赴港看展覽，後在酒吧欲吻她，蜜語躲開。Marcos派對上，紀封瞥見寄舟約見訊息，遂邀蜜語共舞試探。紀封獨自買醉，借著酒勁到蜜語樓下卻見她剛回宿舍…

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Slim益生菌呈獻：南美潮什麼2粵
programme.desc: 伊莎貝拉島的獨特火山岩地形為生物提供優良的棲息環境，芷珮大清早就「船駁船」登島探索，盡情擁抱自然生態。穿過「紅樹林隧道」，躍進湖中玩浮潛，和魚兒、海龜暢泳，逾百隻魔鬼魚湧現一幕更份外震撼！漫步自然保護區，跟鬣蜥打招呼，窺探由火山活動形成的熔岩管，內裡也能找到生物蹤影？捕捉海獅群上岸休息時刻，再近距離觀察「明星級島民」藍腳鰹鳥，芷珮出海途中，更幸運地遇見企鵝！此外，這集帶來酒店情報、乘小型飛機貼士。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
再創世紀#30粵
programme.desc: 小慧無法讓程凱及澤雨和好，一場工廈小火卻令他們冰釋前嫌。明晞為內幕交易案向松蔭求助，松蔭反勸明晞離婚，認為天生不值得她犧牲。眼看形勢不利，天生將主席之位讓予明晞，同時增設四名新董事。明晞處處受董事掣肘，對松蔭之言更認同。松蔭病危，臨終託付明晞入主天蔭協助澤雨，明晞含淚答應。松蔭葬禮上，定垚陪伴澤雨，二人感情默默滋長。澤雨接納明晞提議，用計踢走礙事董事，成為天蔭新任主席。

programme.title: 男朋友(完)
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 青春時代
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳(完)
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.desc: Tyler's up to his usual speedster tricks and must be stopped! Troy enlists Matt's help to stop him from endangering other drivers.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Drag Race
programme.desc: Troy helps Tyler and Jerry race by bringing in a third contender. Now let's see who wins the race!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Frank the Fire Trucks saves Car City
programme.desc: Troy spots a fire in Car City and wastes no time getting Frank to the building to put the fire out!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Gary the Garbage Truck cleans Car City
programme.desc: There's trash all over Car City! Troy selects the perfect truck to take care of it: Gary the Garbage Truck!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Charlie the Crane clear the bridge
programme.desc: Some trees fell and are blocking the bridge! Troy selects the perfect truck to clear it: Charlie the Crane!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is a curious little robot who loves making friends, discovering new things, and having fun with music, magic, animals, and more. Every day is a new adventure for Rookie—whether he’s chasing a bouncing ball, exploring the stars, or learning how something works. He’s always ready to laugh, try again when things get tricky, and share big smiles with the friends he meets along the way. With Rookie, even the smallest moments become exciting discoveries!

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: RoboFuse - RoboFuse - Saving the Race

Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! programme.title: Bluey S02 - Daddy Dropoff
programme.desc: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Piraputanga
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Bonito in the Amazon rainforest on a global adventure to witness piraputanga, a species of fish, leaping from the water to feed on wild berries in the trees above. Along the way, they meet a troop of brown capuchins.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Purple Swamphen
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure in Thailand's wetlands on a mission to discover a way to stop invasive golden apple snails from devouring the vegetation. Along the way, Andy hitches a ride with a bird called a purple swamphen.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Circus
programme.desc: It's Teletubby Circus time! Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa­Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Boots
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say boots and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different boots and explore how they look and feel. We see blue boots, new boots, welly boots and even smelly boots! There's boots to wear in a puddle and boots to wear when you cuddle! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Wiggly Worms
programme.desc: When Mayor Oki's pumpkins aren't big enough Messy and his friends muck in and save the day! With the help of some wiggly worms...

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - 'X' Marks the Swop
programme.desc: An old map, mysterious clues and ancient secrets... Mojo and Bo are after the treasure of the Knights of Swoppiton! But Preston's after it too, so they need to get there first.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch is in New York to see a Broadway show, but can't find anywhere to leave the Grimbler. Then he stumbles on Central Park and decides to build his own car park there. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters drop Kyan off nearby, so he can practice his fantastic gymnastics in the park. Kyan discovers a queue of cars making their way across the grass, with a Grimbot traffic warden directing them towards a huge Grim car park.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Fairies
programme.desc: Bluey's house has fairies! Tails are being braided, stickers are everywhere, and Mum's got a peg beard. Now the family must band together to hunt for these invisible mischief-makers.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Swim School
programme.desc: Mum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass Swim School but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret (aka Bluey) is proving very difficult.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Lost Pachycephalosaurus
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cats
programme.desc: Bella has fun pretending to be a cat - a Bella-Cat. Together with Lift, she visits Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest, who sings a spider rhyme all about taily-waily animals!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea..

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Table Mountain, South Africa
programme.desc: Glitch wants to ski, so the Grimbots give Table Mountain a snowy peak, which threatens its rare plants.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Grudge Match
programme.desc: Raul, the Brazilian tank engine, wants to beat Thomas in a game. But Raul's super-competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Scooter Stand Still
programme.desc: Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah and Duck help him to get it back.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Music Fixer
programme.desc: Sarah's Tuba is making some very peculiar sounds, so a trip to the Music Shop is in order.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Shipwreck
programme.desc: Benjamin and Hettie find an old treasure map that leads to Blue Whiskers' Pirate Shipwreck! They ask Stanley to help them find it and maybe bring it back to show the townsfolk.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Power
programme.desc: Stanley needs to do some jobs for the community, but all his vehicles are out of power due to a cloud of butterflies obscuring them and he needs to figure out how to move them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - That Is SO Bad!
programme.desc: From being cheeky - like eating lots of sweets or watching TV when you're not supposed to - the funny animals chat about what it's like to misbehave.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time To Look For Frogs
programme.desc: At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn. Gran Gran and Cynthia teach them about the life cycle of frog spawn to tadpole and frog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Wish Badge
programme.desc: Whilst helping Duggee clean up, the Squirrels come across an old lamp. Duggee explains that many years ago, when rubbed, it could grant three magical wishes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters fly to the rescue in Japan, as Glitch gets up to his usual monkey business.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Corn
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Orange

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - 'X' Marks the Swop
programme.desc: An old map, mysterious clues and ancient secrets... Mojo and Bo are after the treasure of the Knights of Swoppiton! But Preston's after it too, so they need to get there first.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch is in New York to see a Broadway show, but can't find anywhere to leave the Grimbler. Then he stumbles on Central Park and decides to build his own car park there. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters drop Kyan off nearby, so he can practice his fantastic gymnastics in the park. Kyan discovers a queue of cars making their way across the grass, with a Grimbot traffic warden directing them towards a huge Grim car park.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Fairies
programme.desc: Bluey's house has fairies! Tails are being braided, stickers are everywhere, and Mum's got a peg beard. Now the family must band together to hunt for these invisible mischief-makers.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Swim School
programme.desc: Mum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass Swim School but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret (aka Bluey) is proving very difficult.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Lost Pachycephalosaurus
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Cats
programme.desc: Bella has fun pretending to be a cat - a Bella-Cat. Together with Lift, she visits Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest, who sings a spider rhyme all about taily-waily animals!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea..

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Table Mountain, South Africa
programme.desc: Glitch wants to ski, so the Grimbots give Table Mountain a snowy peak, which threatens its rare plants.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S23 - Grudge Match
programme.desc: Raul, the Brazilian tank engine, wants to beat Thomas in a game. But Raul's super-competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Scooter Stand Still
programme.desc: Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah and Duck help him to get it back.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Music Fixer
programme.desc: Sarah's Tuba is making some very peculiar sounds, so a trip to the Music Shop is in order.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Shipwreck
programme.desc: Benjamin and Hettie find an old treasure map that leads to Blue Whiskers' Pirate Shipwreck! They ask Stanley to help them find it and maybe bring it back to show the townsfolk.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Power
programme.desc: Stanley needs to do some jobs for the community, but all his vehicles are out of power due to a cloud of butterflies obscuring them and he needs to figure out how to move them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - That Is SO Bad!
programme.desc: From being cheeky - like eating lots of sweets or watching TV when you're not supposed to - the funny animals chat about what it's like to misbehave.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran S03 - It's Time To Look For Frogs
programme.desc: At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn. Gran Gran and Cynthia teach them about the life cycle of frog spawn to tadpole and frog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Wish Badge
programme.desc: Whilst helping Duggee clean up, the Squirrels come across an old lamp. Duggee explains that many years ago, when rubbed, it could grant three magical wishes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters fly to the rescue in Japan, as Glitch gets up to his usual monkey business.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Corn
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
programme.desc: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realise she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Veg-O-Vision Song Contest

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Stairs
programme.desc: A musical staircase magically appears in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po take turns making music as they go up and down the stairs.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Bike
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say bike and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different bikes doing lots of different things! There's a hopping bike, a shopping bike and even a dinosaur riding a bike! Dee has a new green and shiny bike and we see her going for a bike ride with loads of friends! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Lemon Cafe

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Flower
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help her find a new place for her friend Isabelle the Sun-bell Daisy. This proves trickier than initially planned as Isabelle has some specific needs.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. After some trial and error, Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time to Dress Up
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran have fun finding Gran Gran's old clothes. When Charlene brings round a sewing machine, it's time for a Gran Gran plan - they can make JoJo some new clothes too!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Music Video Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing a song they made, but they wish that they could see themselves perform. Duggee has a great suggestion, and they learn how to be creative.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The List Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has lost the list he made for the Squirrel's activities for the day at Squirrel Club. After a quick lesson on what a list is, they are happy to help Duggee recreate his.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not

programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Plum performing the Sugar Plum Fairy Bounce and attempting to do not one, not two, but three pirouettes in midair!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Desserts of Destiny
programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato's Museum?

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Tato Tower Sleepover
programme.desc: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Go Outside
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po want to go outside but it's raining. Some wellies and umbrellas magically appear and the Teletubbies go outside for splashy, rainy fun.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Duck
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say duck and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different ducks - a brown duck, a white duck and Dee even goes for a ride in a yellow duck boat! There are baby ducks, mother ducks and lots of funny ducks eating their dinner! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Messy Races
programme.desc: Messy and friends enter a race in OKIDO and the various vehicles speed off! Who has the power to win the mystery prize?!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Swoppiton Duck
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: It's a very windy day at the Go Jet Academy as Jetpad comes in to land, zooming past the academy's windfarm turbines. Meanwhile, in a field nearby, Grandmaster Glitch is teaching his grimbots a lesson all about wind power by trying to fly a giant kite. But as the kite is launched, the strong wind catches it and pulls Glitch up, up and away - and straight towards a huge spinning turbine!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Bumpy And The Wise Old Wolfhound
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad sent her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Postman
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Now Bluey must find a way to play Ground's Lava with Bingo and deliver the letter to Mum, without squabbling.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po want to go outside but it's raining. Some wellies and umbrellas magically appear and the Teletubbies go outside for splashy, rainy fun.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancée enlists a swordsman—who secretly loves her—to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the “speed gang”, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the “speed gang” while on the island – can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the “Tsai Li Fu” style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family…

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, &amp; colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Gao Xing De Suan Tian Ku La - EP39
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Yi Yi Xiang Bei Feng - EP1

programme.title: Nostalgia - Pian Duan Zhan Bo
programme.desc: Nostalgia aims to represent Chinese traditional culture by revealing life in villages in the way of story-telling.

programme.title: TV Guide
programme.desc: Stay tuned to CCTV-4 as we introduce you to the various content and programming on the channel.

programme.title: Network News
